headlines.title: 서울 집주인, 재산세 5119억 더 냈다 [H-EXCLUSIVE]
headlines.summary: 2026년 서울시 주택 재산세 현황 총 3조8961억원…전년比 15.1% 증가 집값·공시가 상승 영향에 세 부담↑ 강남 등 공시가 12억 초과 42% 급등 12억 이하 주택은 8.7% 가량 줄어 올해 서울 주택분 재산세 관련 세액이 5000억원 이상 늘어난 가운데 증가분 상당수가 공시가격 12억 초과 주택에 집중된 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 재산세 증가분 57%가 강남3구 …‘공시가 12억 초과 ’ 한강벨트만 65만채
headlines.summary: 서울 재산세 증가 5119억, 강남3구 2920억↑ 강남3구 재산세 1.7조…서울 전체 44% 차지 동작 210% 상승 등 고가주택 강남 넘어 확산 집값 상승·공시가 인상, 한강변 세부담 확대 서울 중구 남산공원에서 바라본 강남·서초 일대의 아파트 단지의 모습.

headlines.title: " 부동산 세금 , 너무 어려워 "…국세청에 양도세 질의 2배 급증
headlines.summary: 올해 1∼7월 국세청에 접수된 부동산 관련 세금 질의 지난해 전체의 90% 넘어 양도·종부·상증세 질의 총 2726건 올해 부동산 세금에 대한 문의가 급격히 늘어난 것으로 나타났다. 정부의 다주택자 양도세 중과 재개와 장기보유특별공제 등 부동산 세제를 손질하면서 납세자의 불확실성을 키웠다는 지적이다. 특히 양도소득세 질의는 지난해의 2배 가까이로 늘었다.

headlines.title: 반도체 이익, 반도체 투자에만 집중 … 체감 안되는 호황
headlines.summary: 올해 설비투자 7.9% 증가 전망 경제 전반으로 성장 온기 안퍼져 반도체 호황이 기업 이익과 세수는 빠르게 끌어올리고 있지만 임금과 국내 투자로 번지는 속도는 이를 따라가지 못하고 있다. 반도체 중심 성장의 과실이 경제 전반으로 확산되지 못하면서 수출·성장 지표와 체감경기 간 괴리가 커지고 있다는 지적이 나온다.

headlines.title: 관세청, 반도체 공정용 가스 조절장비 ‘ 무관세 결정 ’
headlines.summary: 관세청이 품목 분류 기준을 정비해 그간 3% 관세가 부과됐던 반도체 제조공정용 가스압력 조절 장비를 무관세 품목으로 결정했다. 관세청은 지난달 13일 열린 ‘2026년 5회 관세품목분류위원회’에서 총 9건의 품목분류를 결정했으며, 이를 반영한 ‘수출입물품 등에 대한 품목분류 변경고시’ 개정안을 14일 관보에 게재했다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 韓 경기선행지수, 75개월 만에 17개국 중 1위 … 오름폭은 둔화
headlines.summary: 8월 102.87…5년3개월 만에 최고 지난해 2월부터 19개월 연속 상승 작년 9월 16위에서 올해 1위로 월 상승폭은 0.43→0.06포인트 [대구=뉴시스] 이무열 기자 = 제80주년 광복절인 15일 대구의 한 아파트에 태극기가 게양돼 있다. 2025.08.15. lmy@newsis.

headlines.title: 9~10월 도입 물량 원유 90% 확보했지만 …‘ 비축유 스와프 ’ 총동원

headlines.title: 美금리인상, 유가·환율 상승 … 한은 ‘ 금리 인상 ’ 이어가나
headlines.summary: 연준 금리인상 확률 85.8%로 급등 원화 약세에 고유가까지 ‘이중 충격’ 한은 내달 금통위 추가 인상 주목 미국의 고용과 물가 지표가 잇달아 시장 예상을 웃돌면서 15~16일(현지시간) 열리는 연방공개시장위원회(FOMC)에서 기준금리가 인상될 가능성이 커지고 있다.

headlines.title: “ 비싼 한우는 구경만 ”… 수입 삼겹살 소비 49% 급증
headlines.summary: 1~7월 국산 소고기 판매량 6.6%↓ 수입 돼지 전 부위 2년 새 69.9%↑ 고물가 부담에 육류도 가성비 따져 “요즘 한우는 눈으로만 봅니다.” 퇴근길 마트를 찾은 A씨가 수입산 삼겹살 코너로 이동하면서 말했다. 그는 “당연히 한우를 사고 싶지만, 식비 부담이 늘어 삼겹살을 택하는 날이 많아졌다”고 했다.

top5_headlines.summary: 관세청이 품목 분류 기준을 정비해 그간 3% 관세가 부과됐던 반도체 제조공정용 가스압력 조절 장비를 무관세 품목으로 결정했다. 관세청은 지난달 13일 열린 ‘2026년 5회 관세품목분류위원회’에서 총 9건의 품목분류를 결정했으며, 이를 반영한 ‘수출입물품 등에 대한 품목분류 변경고시’ 개정안을 14일 관보에 게재했다고 밝혔다.

top5_headlines.title: 美금리인상, 유가·환율 상승 … 한은 ‘ 금리 인상 ’ 이어가나
top5_headlines.summary: 연준 금리인상 확률 85.8%로 급등 원화 약세에 고유가까지 ‘이중 충격’ 한은 내달 금통위 추가 인상 주목 미국의 고용과 물가 지표가 잇달아 시장 예상을 웃돌면서 15~16일(현지시간) 열리는 연방공개시장위원회(FOMC)에서 기준금리가 인상될 가능성이 커지고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: " 부동산 세금 , 너무 어려워 "…국세청에 양도세 질의 2배 급증
top5_headlines.summary: 올해 1∼7월 국세청에 접수된 부동산 관련 세금 질의 지난해 전체의 90% 넘어 양도·종부·상증세 질의 총 2726건 올해 부동산 세금에 대한 문의가 급격히 늘어난 것으로 나타났다. 정부의 다주택자 양도세 중과 재개와 장기보유특별공제 등 부동산 세제를 손질하면서 납세자의 불확실성을 키웠다는 지적이다. 특히 양도소득세 질의는 지난해의 2배 가까이로 늘었다.

top5_headlines.title: 반도체 이익, 반도체 투자에만 집중 … 체감 안되는 호황
top5_headlines.summary: 올해 설비투자 7.9% 증가 전망 경제 전반으로 성장 온기 안퍼져 반도체 호황이 기업 이익과 세수는 빠르게 끌어올리고 있지만 임금과 국내 투자로 번지는 속도는 이를 따라가지 못하고 있다. 반도체 중심 성장의 과실이 경제 전반으로 확산되지 못하면서 수출·성장 지표와 체감경기 간 괴리가 커지고 있다는 지적이 나온다.

top5_headlines.title: 韓 경기선행지수, 75개월 만에 17개국 중 1위 … 오름폭은 둔화
top5_headlines.summary: 8월 102.87…5년3개월 만에 최고 지난해 2월부터 19개월 연속 상승 작년 9월 16위에서 올해 1위로 월 상승폭은 0.43→0.06포인트 [대구=뉴시스] 이무열 기자 = 제80주년 광복절인 15일 대구의 한 아파트에 태극기가 게양돼 있다. 2025.08.15. lmy@newsis.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's Customs Service Eliminates Tariffs on Semiconductor Processing Equipment
key_headlines.summary: The Customs Service reclassified gas pressure regulation equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing as duty-free, eliminating the previous 3% tariff. This decision was made at the September tariff classification meeting and published in the Official Gazette.

key_headlines.title: US Federal Reserve Rate Hike Probability Surges to 85.8% Amid Strong Employment and Inflation Data
key_headlines.summary: Strong US employment and inflation indicators have raised the likelihood of a rate hike at the upcoming FOMC meeting to 85.8%, which could trigger won weakness and higher oil prices. The Bank of Korea is expected to continue monitoring for potential rate increases in response.

key_headlines.title: Real Estate Tax Inquiries Double as Confusion Over Property Tax Reforms Surges
key_headlines.summary: Property-related tax inquiries to the National Tax Service jumped dramatically to 90% of last year's total in just seven months, with capital gains tax questions nearly doubling. Government changes to multiple property owner transfer tax and long-term holding deductions have created significant uncertainty among taxpayers.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's Economic Leading Index Ranks First Among 17 Nations Despite Slowing Growth Pace
key_headlines.summary: Korea's leading economic index reached 102.87 in August, marking the highest level in five years and three months, and ranked first among 17 countries for the first time in 75 months. However, the monthly growth pace has slowed from 0.43 to 0.06 percentage points.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Boom Profits Fail to Spread to Broader Economy, Widening Growth-Sentiment Gap
key_headlines.summary: While semiconductor profitability continues to drive corporate earnings and tax revenue, the benefits are not translating into wage increases or broader domestic investment. Capital equipment investment is expected to rise only 7.9% this year, creating a disconnect between export growth indicators and actual economic sentiment.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea is experiencing mixed economic signals as semiconductor profitability drives headline numbers but fails to translate into broad-based growth. The government has made tariff adjustments favoring semiconductor equipment while property tax reforms have created confusion among taxpayers, leading to doubled inquiries about capital gains taxes. The country's leading economic index reached a five-year-three-month high and ranked first among 17 nations, though growth momentum is decelerating. Meanwhile, the potential for US Federal Reserve rate hikes at 85.8% probability threatens to put additional pressure on the won and raise import costs, particularly for energy.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Korean economy faces external headwinds as US monetary policy tightening becomes increasingly likely following stronger-than-expected employment and inflation data. August export prices fell 3.7% from the previous month to their lowest level in three years and eight months, while import prices declined 2.4% as the weakening won currency provided some offset to rising oil prices. The Bank of Korea is expected to consider rate adjustments in response to Federal Reserve movements, as the won's weakness against the dollar continues to influence pricing dynamics. Property tax uncertainties have surged, with capital gains tax inquiries nearly doubling as the government's revised transfer tax policies for multiple property owners remain poorly understood by taxpayers.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market faces significant headwinds from rising US Treasury yields, with the 10-year rate breaking through the 5% barrier amid expectations for Fed rate hikes and concerns about AI development sustainability. The KOSPI has declined for four consecutive trading days, pulled down by both the weakness in US technology stocks and foreign investor selling, which has reached 204 trillion won in outflows this year alone. Oil price volatility stemming from Middle East tensions compounds market uncertainty, while rate decisions from major global central banks this week present additional risk. The stock market is caught between concerns about higher global rates dampening valuations and worries about AI growth sustainability, creating a challenging environment for Korean equities despite the strong semiconductor sector performance.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's semiconductor equipment and materials sector continues to benefit from government tariff adjustments and strong demand for AI-related chips, with international competitors like Teradyne seeing 80% share price increases. However, Korean battery makers face intensifying competition as 40% of domestically sold electric vehicles now use Chinese batteries, forcing companies to shift focus toward North American energy storage system markets. Advanced sensor development is gaining momentum across the semiconductor industry with government support, as companies recognize the critical role of sensors in AI and robotics applications. Corporate M&A activity continues with interest in robotics, hydrogen vehicle components, and petrochemical-related assets, reflecting industrial restructuring trends.
sections.Real Estate: The real estate market shows mixed signals with government support for affordable housing through long-term lease programs in premium areas like Gangnam, while property tax burdens increase despite some relief measures for single-home owners. Gwangju apartment prices have risen for nine consecutive weeks following the announcement of semiconductor facility investments, prompting the government to designate large areas as land transaction restricted zones. High-end residential transactions remain active in Seoul, with premium properties in areas like Gangnam selling for 50-80 billion won despite overall market cooling. Property tax revenues are rising alongside real estate prices, though uncertainty about transfer tax policies continues to generate taxpayer confusion and increased government inquiries.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve's anticipated rate hike at 85.8% probability creates global uncertainty and threatens to pressure the Korean won, as markets price in higher financing costs and stronger dollar dynamics. Trade policy under the Trump administration remains unpredictable, with tariff decisions made casually—such as the recent elimination of Irish whiskey tariffs announced at a golf event—while threats loom to suspend trade with countries that run surpluses with the US if rate hikes proceed. The Fed faces potential conflict with President Trump, who has advocated for rate reductions, creating policy uncertainty that complicates expectations for both American and global markets. Middle East tensions continue to drive oil price volatility, with supply concerns adding another layer of uncertainty to global economic conditions.
sections.AI & Economy: Artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming embedded in industrial applications and economic decision-making, from semiconductor material discovery that accelerates research timelines from 22 months to just days, to investment advisory applications that still require human final approval in 76% of cases among wealthy younger investors. Concerns about AI development sustainability have surfaced among tech sector analysts, though broader industry consensus suggests competition pressures and US-China strategic rivalry make slowdowns unlikely despite environmental and societal concerns. Korean companies are positioning themselves in AI-driven markets like data centers and energy storage, though they face significant competitive and pricing pressures. AI is increasingly recognized as essential for future industrial competitiveness, with government and industry cooperation expanding through initiatives like new R&D centers focusing on AI-based biotechnology and energy solutions.
sections.Others: Lotte and KAIST have jointly completed an R&D center in Daejeon with 10 billion won in Lotte funding, focusing on AI-based biotechnology, carbon-neutral energy, and healthcare technology development. LS Electric has partnered with Korea Electric Power Corporation to jointly develop grid-forming technology for power distribution systems aimed at global export markets. Concerns about unauthorized imports of weight-loss medications like Ozempic continue, as these drugs face restricted entry into Korea but remain available at lower prices in Japan, creating arbitrage opportunities and regulatory enforcement challenges. Economic growth of around 3% may be necessary for the US to navigate current fiscal and inflation challenges, though achieving such growth rates faces structural headwinds from demographic changes and policy uncertainty.
